name: VA TURP versus watchful waiting
question: Does immediate transurethral resection reduce treatment failure compared with watchful waiting in men with moderate BPH symptoms?

arms.label: Immediate transurethral resection of the prostate

design.population: 556 men older than 54 years with moderate symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia.

verdictNote: Watchful-waiting crossover to surgery reached 65/276 (24%) by three years.
takeaway: In men with moderate BPH symptoms, immediate transurethral resection reduced three-year composite treatment failure versus watchful waiting (23/280 versus 47/276; RR 0.48, 95% CI 0.30–0.77).

reports.label: Three-year primary report
reports.citation: Wasson JH, Reda DJ, Bruskewitz RC, et al. "A Comparison of Transurethral Surgery with Watchful Waiting for Moderate Symptoms of Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia." *N Engl J Med.* 1995;332(2):75-79. doi:10.1056/NEJM199501123320202
reports.followUp: Mean 2.8 years; planned follow-up three years

results.note: Intention-to-treat; composite included death, retention, postvoid residual above 350 mL, bladder calculus, persistent new incontinence, high symptom score, or doubled creatinine.

results.measure: Symptom, urinary-difficulty, and daily-activity interference scores
results.note: The greatest benefit was reported among men most bothered by urinary symptoms at baseline.

harms.label: Impotence and urinary incontinence
harms.note: Surgery was not associated with impotence or urinary incontinence in the reported comparison; absolute rates were not in the abstract.

delivery.label: Early TURP receipt
delivery.value: 249/280 (89%) assigned to surgery underwent TURP within two weeks of randomization.

delivery.label: Watchful-waiting crossover
delivery.value: 65/276 (24%) assigned to watchful waiting underwent surgery within three years.

reports.label: Five-year follow-up
reports.citation: Flanigan RC, Reda DJ, Wasson JH, et al. "5-Year Outcome of Surgical Resection and Watchful Waiting for Men with Moderately Symptomatic Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia: A Department of Veterans Affairs Cooperative Study." *J Urol.* 1998;160(1):12-17. doi:10.1016/S0022-5347(01)63011-8
reports.followUp: Up to five years; 966 TURP and 990 watchful-waiting patient-years
reports.followUpLocator: Europe PMC abstract, Materials and Methods

results.measure: Five-year treatment-failure risk; risk difference in percentage points
results.note: Risk difference in percentage points, calculated from the rounded percentages in the abstract; outcome denominators were not reported there.

delivery.label: Watchful-waiting crossover at five years
delivery.value: 36% of men assigned to watchful waiting crossed over to surgery.
